intro.title: Catch the Jeep
intro.lead: Find the yellow Jeep with black lightning bolts, red dots and a POKEMON plate. Point your camera at it, swipe up to throw the ball, then share your catch.
intro.imageAlt: The campaign Jeep: bright yellow with black lightning bolts, red dots and a POKEMON number plate
intro.caption: Only this Jeep counts
intro.privacy: Your camera stays on your phone. Nothing is uploaded.
